checks.name: One real media stream, automatic player isolation and full-picture fit
Automatically grows through two, three, four and six games
Every manual layout and Fit/Fill update actual rendered tiles
Landscape and portrait layouts stay inside the screen without overlapping
Controls hide after inactivity and small-tile menus remain usable
Audio switching and mute-all leave at most one game audible
Duplicate sources and the seventh game cannot create extra captures
25 replacement/removal cycles release old streams and preserve the six-game limit
Removing an expanded game restores the grid and stops its tracks
Failed replacement keeps the old game playing and allows retry
Scrolling/resizing player data and missing-player fallback update cleanly
Real player detector finds an actual video and follows source scrolling/resizing
Real detector refuses ambiguous or partly offscreen players
Real frame navigation releases every attached capture

limitations: Extension capture and messaging APIs are simulated; DOM, layout, media elements and MediaStreams are real.
No DRM, protected services, external sites or long-session performance claims.
